classes.B1_PRODUCT_OR_OWNER_DECISION: A product, scope, or owner approval is required.
classes.B2_CODE_OR_ARCHITECTURE: A code or architecture change is required before acceptance.
classes.B3_SECURITY_OR_SYSTEM_REVIEW: A security or system-design review/evidence gate is required.
classes.B4_LIVE_HOST_OR_OPERATOR_EVIDENCE: A live-host or operator-controlled verification is required.
classes.B5_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT_DNS_SECRET: An external provider, account, DNS, or secret-controlled action is required.
classes.B6_REAL_WORLD_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_OR_LEGAL: Human, accessibility, visual, legal, or owner acceptance is required.
